owner_correction: The point is to learn to humanize; do not veer into article-completion, publishing, sidecar, or other adjacent avenues before the method itself has been learned and demonstrated.

diagnosis.description: After the assembled Stage-2 passage received an architecture PASS, the supervisor treated remaining preservation, safety, technical, and publishing obligations as the next work. That converted a humanization-learning experiment back into an article-completion workflow.
mechanism: Architecture PASS was incorrectly interpreted as completion authority rather than experimental evidence.
Unrealized preservation/safety units created closure pressure, so the supervisor began placing them into footnotes/sidecars instead of stopping to extract and test the generation lesson.
Repository publishing/preservation machinery was allowed to outrank the experiment's top-level objective.
The active 094 strategy's orchestration checkpoint and success criterion were not honored literally.

evidence_status.interpretation: Useful evidence that the fresh-writer + local-pressure + architecture-first + deletion/assembly process can produce one acceptable boundary.
not_proven: The generator has internalized the method.
The method transfers to a held-out passage.
The method works without heavy sentence-specific prompting or critic repair.
Owner correction burden has materially decreased.
The same structural failures will not recur on a new target.

post_pass_work_status.note: Retain artifacts only as provenance of the drift. Do not advance or install them unless Joel later explicitly returns to article-completion/publishing work.

next_method_test.purpose: Test whether the learned humanization method generalizes rather than continuing to optimize the same passage.
protocol: Extract the smallest process lessons actually supported by the Stage-2 iterations; do not turn them into a long anti-pattern blacklist.
Choose a different existing model-shaped passage with authoritative semantics and no owner-final wording as a held-out target.

Give a genuinely fresh writer only the semantic/source thought, local article context, and live reader pressure needed to write naturally; withhold failed prose, preservation ledgers, detector feedback, and sentence-specific repair history.
Have a genuinely fresh architecture critic judge the literal output before preservation is allowed to defend it.
Only after architecture passes, run preservation/reverse-traceability checks.

Measure learning by first-pass architecture quality, recurrence of known failure classes, amount/type of critic repair, and owner correction burden, not by whether all article obligations were placed.
If the same structural failure recurs, change the generation architecture rather than adding another prohibition.
